hero: From shopfront signs to staff uniforms, Print Garage helps Kampala businesses get their branding made. Bring us your artwork, quantities and ideas for print, clothing and promotional items that suit your next project.
about: We help Kampala businesses present themselves through printed materials, branded garments, signage and useful giveaways. At Print Garage, each enquiry starts with what you need, where it will be used and the quantities involved.
mission: Make print and branding orders clear and manageable, with careful attention to artwork, product specifications and the customer's brief.
vision: A dependable Kampala destination for businesses seeking distinctive print, workwear and promotional branding.
purpose: Help organisations look consistent wherever people meet them: at their premises, on their team and in the items they share.
partners: Recognising the businesses and organisations in our partner community.
